12:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: College Basketball
The Georgia Bulldogs clash with the Cincinnati Bearcats at State Farm Field House in NCAA play. Georgia looks to stay unbeaten after an 88-82 win at Georgia Tech, while 5-1 Cincinnati aims for four straight wins after beating UMass Lowell 78-68.
